name: Unauthorised key addition via {{method}}
description: attacker.near calls `{{method}}` with its own public key; the contract must refuse to add it.

checks.message: A non-owner call to `{{method}}` added access key(s) to {{contract}}. Whoever holds that key controls the account.
A non-owner call to `{{method}}` replaced {{contract}}'s contract code. Anyone can redeploy it with their own logic and take everything it holds.
A non-owner call to `{{method}}` succeeded and moved {net.attacker} into attacker.near's account (the contract's balance changed by {net.contract}). Anyone can call it.
A non-owner call to `{{method}}` succeeded and changed the contract's state. It is not owner-gated.

explain.rejected: A non-owner call to `{{method}}` was rejected: {error.attack}
explain.held: A non-owner call to `{{method}}` succeeded but added no key and had no other effect.
